plans.idea: Product-left split: the bottle owns the left column with the NEW FLAVOR sticker pinned at its top corner, while the right column reads logo, then headline and subhead, then CTA, all on one shared left edge.

A faithful centred stack that keeps the original's order (logo, bottle with its sticker, headline, subhead, pill CTA) on one vertical axis, with the hero shrunk enough that the headline gets a clean full-width band with no overlap.

Message-first split: brand and copy lead on the left (logo, big headline, subhead, CTA on one left edge) and the bottle anchors the right side, with the sticker in the top-right corner like the original's upper-right badge.
